title: Returns and refunds
text: You may request a return within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused with original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after inspection.

title: Delivery times and tracking
text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days within Egypt. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days where available. Tracking appears in the order page after dispatch.

title: Accepted payment methods
text: Demo Shop accepts Visa, Mastercard, and cash on delivery in Egypt. We never ask customers to send full card numbers, card security codes, passwords or one-time codes to support.

title: Cancel an order
text: An order can be cancelled before dispatch from the order page. After dispatch, use the return process after delivery. Support cannot cancel dispatched orders.

title: Damaged or missing items
text: Report a damaged or missing item within 48 hours of delivery using the order help page. Include the order reference and a photo of the package. Do not share payment credentials.

title: Warranty coverage
text: Electronics include a 12-month manufacturer warranty for manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and normal wear are excluded. Proof of purchase is required.

title: Data and privacy requests
text: Request account-data export or deletion through the privacy form in your account settings. The demo policy targets a response within 30 days. Identity verification uses the secure account page.

title: Change delivery address
text: The delivery address can be changed in the order page before dispatch. After dispatch, contact the courier using the tracking page. Changes depend on courier availability.

title: Account access
text: Use the password reset link on the sign-in page if you cannot access your account. Never send your password or login verification code to support.

title: Support opening hours
text: Demo Shop support operates Sunday to Thursday, 9 AM to 5 PM Cairo time. Requests outside these hours are handled on the next business day.
